page: City page: B2B lead generation Bengaluru (/b2b-lead-generation-bengaluru)

items.question: Do we need to be based in Bengaluru to work with you?
items.answer: No. The entire engagement runs remotely, so it doesn't matter where your team sits.

items.question: Do you only work with Bengaluru companies?
items.answer: No. We have clients in Bengaluru, but we run outbound systems for B2B SaaS and tech companies across India and internationally.

items.question: How quickly can we expect meetings to start?
items.answer: Most clients see their first qualified conversations within 3 to 4 weeks of kickoff, once ICP mapping, list building, and sequence setup are complete.

items.question: What does pricing look like?
items.answer: We work on a monthly retainer with a 3-month minimum, which covers setup and enough sending to judge results. After that it runs month to month with 30 days' notice, with no annual contract.

items.question: Are you a B2B marketing agency or a lead generation company?
items.answer: Myntmore is an outbound lead generation agency, not a full-service B2B marketing agency. We run cold email, LinkedIn outreach, account-based marketing and founder personal branding to start sales conversations. We don't run paid ads, SEO or brand design, so pair us with a marketing agency if you need those too.

items.question: Can you help a Bangalore SaaS company sell to the US or UK?
items.answer: Yes. For Bangalore SaaS teams selling abroad, we build separate sending infrastructure, write copy that reads as native to that market, send in the buyer's time zone and follow CAN-SPAM and GDPR rules. Our case studies include campaigns into the US, the UK and other international markets.

items.question: Which Bengaluru company types do you have the most experience with?
items.answer: B2B SaaS, tech startups, and deep-tech companies are where we've run the most campaigns, but our system adapts to any B2B ICP.

items.question: What channels do you actually use to generate leads?
items.answer: Primarily cold email and LinkedIn outreach tuned for sophisticated SaaS and tech buyers, layered with account-based marketing for named target accounts, and AI-assisted signal tracking and personalisation underneath all three. We pick the mix based on where your buyers, in India or overseas, actually spend their attention.

items.question: How is this different from hiring an in-house SDR?
items.answer: Hiring an in-house SDR in Bengaluru means months of recruiting and ramp-up in one of the country's most competitive hiring markets, before they're fully productive. A managed outbound system has multiple channels live within about three weeks, at a fraction of that fully loaded cost, and scales without you managing headcount.

items.question: What do you need from us to get started?
items.answer: A clear picture of your ICP (even a rough one works), access to a domain we can set up for outbound sending, and about an hour of your time for an onboarding call. We handle ICP refinement, list building, sequence writing, and day-to-day campaign management from there.
